summary: The note describes the National Institute of Education (NIE), an autonomous institute of Nanyang Technological University in Singapore. It is the sole teacher education institute for teachers in Singapore and offers initial teacher preparation, graduate and in-service programmes, and courses for serving teachers, department heads, vice-principals and principals. The note also cites its 2015 QS ranking in Education and its enrolment of over 5,600 full-time equivalent students.
one_line: Overview of the National Institute of Education, Singapore's sole teacher education institute within Nanyang Technological University.
key_facts: The National Institute of Education (NIE) is an autonomous institute of Nanyang Technological University (NTU) in Singapore.
NIE was ranked 12th in the world and 2nd in Asia by the QS World University Rankings in the subject of Education in 2015.
The National Institute of Education is the sole teacher education institute for teachers in Singapore.
NIE provides all levels of teacher education, ranging from initial teacher preparation to graduate and in-service programmes.
NIE offers courses for serving teachers, department heads, vice-principals and principals.
NIE's enrolment stands at more than 5,600 full-time equivalent students.
The institute was first established as the Teachers' Training College in 1950.
